Partner Program

# Earn 20% recurring commission
for every team you refer

Sherlock Calls solves a specific pain for voice AI teams — debugging call failures across Twilio, ElevenLabs, and other providers in seconds, not hours. If your audience builds or operates voice AI, refer them and earn 20% of every payment they make — forever.

[Apply to become a partner→](https://usesherlock.promotekit.com)
Free to join. No approval wait time. Start sharing immediately.

What you get

## Built to reward long-term partners

✓

### 20% recurring commission

Earn 20% of every payment your referred customers make — for the lifetime of their subscription. Not a one-time referral fee.

✓

### 90-day cookie window

Any customer who clicks your link and subscribes within 90 days is attributed to you — even if they don't sign up on the first visit.

✓

### Real-time dashboard

Track clicks, signups, and commissions in real time. Payouts processed monthly when you reach the $50 minimum threshold.

✓

### Built for voice AI teams

Sherlock Calls solves a specific, painful problem for teams running Twilio, ElevenLabs, Vapi, and Retell. Your audience already feels the pain — the pitch is short.

Who it is for

## The right partner has a voice AI audience

- →Voice AI agencies and system integrators
- →Twilio, Vapi, or ElevenLabs consultants
- →RevOps and SalesOps agencies working with voice AI clients
- →Creators and newsletter writers covering voice AI, AI agents, or developer tools
- →Freelancers who build and maintain voice AI pipelines for clients
Not sure if you qualify? [Send us a message](/contact) and we will let you know within one business day.

How it works

## Three steps to your first commission

1. 01

### Apply and get your link

Sign up via the partner portal. You get a unique referral link immediately — no approval delay.
2. 02
Share your link in your newsletter, Discord, agency proposals, or client onboarding docs. We provide copy and product screenshots.
3. 03

### Earn every month

Every time a referred customer pays, you earn 20%. Commissions are tracked in real time and paid monthly.

FAQ

## Partner program questions

### Who qualifies as a partner?

Anyone who works with or writes for voice AI teams — agencies, consultants, freelancers, creators. If your audience builds or operates voice AI, you are a fit.

### How are commissions calculated?

You earn 20% of every payment your referred customers make. On the $50/month Team plan, that is $10/month per customer — for as long as they remain a subscriber.

### When do I get paid?

Commissions are processed monthly once you reach the $50 payout minimum. Payment is via bank transfer or PayPal.

### What marketing materials do you provide?

We provide your unique referral link, copy templates, and product screenshots. Email hello@usesherlock.ai after applying and we will send a partner kit.

### Is there a cap on earnings?

No. The 20% commission applies to all referred customers and all plan tiers, with no cap.

## Start earning today

Free to join. No minimum traffic requirement. No approval wait. Your first commission can start accruing the day you apply.

[Apply to the partner program→](https://usesherlock.promotekit.com)
